Wonderful group of walkers greatly recommend Wiggle!

Since she was a puppy, Wiggle Dog Walks were always a joy and valuable social group for Butter. It's thanks to all her walkers and local dog groups that she's as sweet and friendly as she is today. We highly recommend Wiggle Dog Walks to anyone who's looking for kind and responsible dog walkers who take care to know your pet and pair them with the best possible pups on their walks.

Really fantastic service. I used Wiggle for approximately six months when I was living in their service area and only stopped because I moved. I absolutely loved their service. Everyone i interacted with was kind and cared deeply about dogs. Rodrigo in particular is a joy to deal with and he is incredibly patient with my dog, he sat on the floor with her and allowed her to get comfortable with him, moving at her speed. Lastly, they finish every walk with one (or several) photos of your dog on the walk, which is an adorable touch.
Always a positive experience with the Wiggles team.
I can't say enough great things about Wiggle Walks! They are so great with dogs and are really warm, professional, and reliable. My dog loves his walks so much-I recommend them highly!
